name: 176. Responses history output_text keeps logprobs absent (#7990) (responses-history-logprobs)
description: Gateway regression for #7990. A client (Pi, via the OpenAI-compatible Responses route) replays an assistant output_text history block with `annotations: []` and no `logprobs`. Bifrost decoded the block into ResponsesOutputMessageContentText, whose LogProbs field had no omit tag, so the re-marshaled provider body carried `logprobs: null`; strict Responses backends reject it with `Invalid type for 'input[N].content[0].logprobs': expected an array ... got null`. Real OpenAI may tolerate the null, so the cases read the outbound body via x-bf-send-back-raw-request instead of relying on an upstream 400. Cases: (1) /openai/v1/responses, the reporter's route: raw_request input[0].content[0] has no logprobs key (pre-fix: logprobs null); (2) /v1/responses with an explicit `logprobs: []`: it stays an empty array (guards against an omitempty over-correction); (3) /openai/v1/responses streaming, Pi's actual shape: the replay completes. Run with FEATURE=responses-history-logprobs.
